fuente.titulo: Uruguayan Bishops visit Rome ahead of Pope Leo’s November visit

titular: Uruguay's bishops prepare for Pope Leo's visit
bajada: Ad limina visit to Rome ahead of the November 6-8 papal trip to Uruguay
caption: Uruguay's Catholic bishops traveled to Rome for their ad limina visit, sharing hopes for the Church's mission in a secularized society ahead of Pope Leo XIV's Apostolic Journey to Uruguay, scheduled for November 6-8. Source: Vatican News, Sept 17, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A group of bishops in formal cassocks walk through a Vatican courtyard toward St. Peter's dome, positioned in the upper right third, with the left and center foreground open and uncluttered.
